```cypher
MATCH (essential:Plugin {component: 'theme_essential'})
OPTIONAL MATCH (essential)-[:SUPPORTS]->(essentialRelease:MoodleRelease)
WITH essential, COLLECT(essentialRelease.release) AS essentialSupportedReleases
MATCH (p:Plugin)
WHERE p.plugin_type = 'theme'
  AND p.in_directory = true
  AND p.installations IS NOT NULL AND p.installations > 0
  AND p.last_release_ts IS NOT NULL AND p.last_release_ts >= apoc.date.parse('2026-09-10', 's', 'yyyy-MM-dd') - duration('P2Y').seconds
  AND p.component <> 'theme_essential'
OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:SUPPORTS]->(r:MoodleRelease)
WHERE r.release IN ['4.0', '4.1', '4.2', '4.3', '4.4', '4.5', '4.6', '4.7', '4.8', '4.9'] OR r.release IN essentialSupportedReleases
WITH p, COLLECT(DISTINCT r.release) AS supportedReleases
WHERE SIZE(supportedReleases) > 0
RETURN p.component, p.name, p.installations, p.last_release_ts, supportedReleases
ORDER BY p.installations DESC, p.last_release_ts DESC
LIMIT 100
```
